disposition_reason: REP24/CF17 sets no cocoa limit. It records that Cd MLs for chocolate (<30%, >=30-<50%, >=50-<70%, >=70% total cocoa solids) and 100% cocoa powder plus CXC 81-2022 were adopted between 2018 and 2022, that JECFA91 found cocoa products contribute 0.1-9.4% of dietary Cd exposure, and that CXC 81-2022 is the basis for new general Cd CoP work.
disposition_locator: Para. 130 (PDF p. 26); Appendix IX project document section 2 (PDF p. 69)

study.material_scope: context on Codex cocoa Cd MLs and cocoa-bean CoP

controls.control: Code of Practice for the Prevention and Reduction of Cadmium Contamination in Cocoa Beans (CXC 81-2022) cited as the basis for a general Cd CoP
